title: Always a place of learning/teaching or a place of commerce/trade
content: I've had many dreams of malls, schools, churches. Mostly leaning toward schools and most often spiritual places like churches, temples. The malls and schools are always busy, bustling. I'm usually a student in those. The churches/temples are always long abandoned or sometimes just empty at the time. I usually go through many rooms of different kinds, most of them large, with high ceilings and lots of intricate architecture. Huge tiled baths, showers and restrooms are a very common theme, usually seeming outdated or antique. I was able to become lucid in one of these dreams (after a lot of trying over a period of weeks) and immediately tried to fly, which woke me up- interestingly, nobody noticed me or cared. This was on a boardwalk just outside a huge mall. My church I attended as a child is the setting of probably 1 out of 5 of these dreams, always being empty and after hours, I'm almost always alone. It's a large place with lots of empty rooms. And there's always an element of home to these places, like I stay there or live there. In one of the dreams I even lived in a small annex building of the same church. I'm not a christian, per se, anymore- but I'm fascinated by religion of all kinds, so I wonder if there's a connection there. The most recent dream was living in the church annex building, like I was clergy. And before that the dream was a large empty mall, with one whole side being a giant abandoned arcade.
